notes:
- **Speech services › Add custom API asks "Which service?" too.** Together (Whisper and others), Mistral (Voxtral) and Speaches on this PC (no key) fill in their own address; **Other (OpenAI-compatible)** keeps the plain form, and entries you made before open that way, unchanged. **Model** is a list asked of the server (a text box with the reason when it can't), the extra header and an editable Base URL sit under **Advanced**, and **Test** sends the 2-second clip and says in plain words what's wrong. Each says it doesn't tell speakers apart, so Meeting notes show **One speaker for everyone else**. See [Adding another service](/docs/speech-models/#adding-another-service).
- **The "Add custom API" tile is one tile tall** in both Speech services and Language models, however tall the tiles beside it are.
